_comment: Research-preview only. See backend/app/relapse/predictor.py (ModelPredictor) and backend/ml/README.md's Known limitations section before changing anything here.
source_artifact: backend/ml/models/cravinglog_compatible__random_forest.joblib, copied unchanged into this tracked location so a fresh checkout can load it without depending on the gitignored backend/ml/ directory
dataset: EMASENS_ML (Perski et al., 2024), Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10472386, v2.0.0

thresholds.note: These are THIS model's own derived thresholds (backend/ml/outputs/training_metadata.json, results_summary.cravinglog_compatible.random_forest.derived_thresholds) - NOT the top-level risk_thresholds in that file, which belong to the full_ema/random_forest model instead.

warning: ROC-AUC ~0.50 on held-out EMASENS_ML data = chance level, not a working predictor. Not clinically validated. Never the production default (see app/config.py RELAPSE_PREDICTOR_MODE) and never exposed to end users - research-preview / demo path only.

reproduction_verified.method: python -m ml.train re-run from backend/ (same code, same EMASENS_ML dataset, same random_seed=555, same library versions)
reproduction_verified.result: Bit-for-bit identical output: cravinglog_compatible__random_forest.joblib SHA-256 cbc47f4770a392caac2c2b3cf8f5609e65933db378cd19c9c7a83c0db969d306 matched exactly, all metrics (roc_auc, thresholds) unchanged. The .joblib file in this directory was not replaced, since it was already identical to the new run's output - confirms the pipeline is fully deterministic and reproducible from a fresh checkout.
